title: Attempt readiness loop evals
purpose: Show whether a bounded repo slice and simulated user answer can be evaluated into grounded gaps, repair actions, re-evaluation prompts, and scoped readiness labels.
protects: artifact boundary evidence cannot come from out-of-scope paths
gap detection distinguishes grounded understanding from partial, wrong, overconfident, uncertain, or design-induced confusion
repair generation and re-evaluation stay tied to the declared mastery checks
readiness labels are scoped to the evaluated attempt instead of repo-wide mastery

artifacts.description: Declares included paths, excluded paths, concepts, and dataset indexes for this readiness slice.
Lists the prompts and evidence requirements that define each checked concept.
Lists deterministic simulated answers and expected classifications.
Case payloads consumed by deterministic and freeform evaluators.

evaluations.title: Attempt readiness manifest and gold case validator
evaluations.answers: Are the manifest, mastery checks, gold cases, and scoped evidence requirements internally consistent?

evaluations.title: Attempt readiness deterministic benchmark
evaluations.answers: Do deterministic gap labels, issue candidates, repair actions, and readiness decisions match the gold cases?

evaluations.title: Attempt readiness freeform evaluator
evaluations.answers: Can freeform user answers be scored consistently against expected evidence, gap, repair, and re-evaluation outcomes?
